newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cardoso says CVRD sell-off battle won.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cardoso says CVRD sell-off battle won.

text.p: Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso said Friday state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) would be privatized despite mounting opposition to the sell-off.
Cardoso told foreign journalists in a briefing that the government had already won the battle to reform the Brazilian economy.
"Vale (CVRD) doesn't even have to be discussed anymore. It will be privatized," Cardoso said. "This we have already won. The reform of the economy has already happened."
Opposition to the sell-off stiffened this week with the establishment of an anti-privatization front by former presidents Itamar Franco and Jose Sarney.
The auction is slated to begin in February with a block sale of 40-45 percent of voting shares.
Cardoso has denied he may compromise with Congress over CVRD in order to win votes for his bid for re-election.
